chosen_titles.rationale: Title 24 'LEGISLATURE AND LOBBYING' explicitly names lobbying in its title and is the canonical home of Alaska's lobbying-disclosure statute (AS 24.45 Regulation of Lobbying).

notes: AK 2010 Justia index lists 47 titles; Title 24 is the sole lobbying-disclosure home. Title 39 (Public Officers and Employees) houses general ethics provisions but does not contain the lobbying-disclosure registration/reporting regime, which is statutorily codified in AS 24.45.
